key_claims: Alejandro Valverde crashed and abandoned Stage 7 of the Vuelta España after sliding off on a descent approximately 40 kilometers into the stage
Valverde is 42 years old and was world champion just two years prior to this race
Michael Storer won Stage 7 with the climb featuring pitches so steep he had to use a zigzag pattern similar to a postman climbing a hill
Adam Yates set a tempo pace that only Roglic, Yates, Lopez, Bernal, Delacruz, and Oinerk Masz could follow, with other GC contenders like Landa, Carapaz, and Vlasov dropping
Roglic held the red jersey with Gómez Schartner in second place, only 8 seconds behind
specific_numbers: 40 kilometers into the stage when Valverde crashed
Oinerk Masz at 25 seconds in GC
Superman Lopez at 36 seconds in GC
5km to go when climb got spicy
cluster_reasoning: This is pro cycling coverage focused on race narrative, GC battle drama, and iconic moments (Valverde's age and former world champion status) rather than training methodology or athlete performance science.
